product_launches.description: Common Paper launched Gerri 2.0, a major upgrade to its AI contract negotiation agent, adding a faster engine, broader contract support, personality settings, optional attorney review, and template improvement features, now available at getgerri.ai.

overview_description.description: Common Paper is a contract-tech startup that helps companies build, negotiate, and sign contracts faster. Common Paper standardizes contracts and the language they use, converting them into APIs and automating the contracting process. Common Paper also provides a solution for managing contract workflow in order to shorten sales cycles and make data easily accessible through computer programming.

about_short_description.short_description: Common Paper develops contract collaboration software to improve the process of commercial contracting.

product.name: Common Paper Contract Management
product.description: A contract lifecycle management platform for startups to create, negotiate, send, sign, store, bill, and renew commercial agreements using structured contract data.

product.name: Gerri AI Contract Review
product.description: An AI contract review agent that applies playbooks to Word and PDF contracts, recommends or inserts counterlanguage, and escalates exceptions to legal, security, finance, or sales owners.

product.name: Common Paper Standard Agreements
product.description: A library of attorney-maintained, open-source commercial contract templates for SaaS sales, confidentiality, privacy, service levels, professional services, partnerships, and related business use cases.
